text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Foreign Ministry denies any official link to delegation of Kuwaiti academics who last week visited Yemen, one of several Arab states which it accused of sympathising with former occupier Iraq during the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
- Iranian arrested with eight kg (17.6 lb) of illicit drugs.

- Washington recently asked Tehran to hold a "serious and deep dialogue", a political source in Iran said. The United States and Iran, once close, have been at odds since Iran's 1979 Islamic revolution.
- Saudi Arabian and French businessmen to hold seminars in France in November.

- Qatar might cancel the fourth Middle East and North Africa (MENA) economic summit due to convene in Doha in November if Israel fails to change its policies, an Arab League official says. Qatar has said it would host the annual summit on time despite opposition by some Arab states who say Israel must first break a deadlock in the Middle East peace process.
- GCC delegation on Sunday to visit the European parliament and later the European Union headquarters as part of efforts to boost trade and investment between the two economic blocks.
- Coast Guard foil attempt by 23 Iranians to enter the country illegaly.
- Thirty firms to participate in Kuwait's gifts exhibition in September.
